modernization-b12-baseline-abel-clear.purpose: Supplementary paired shallow-main-roof appearance at two original chapel placements. No GPU-cost interval.

method: Direct developer harness in original Nogova R01WarCry and Malden 01TakeTheCar gameplay; copied profiles, --nosound, sync validation. Auto/TAA100%, RT sun/cloud shadows; AO/water/volumetrics off, one bounce. Warm10, Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6, probes off, no build/census/other game during timing. Not Steam-route or mission-completion acceptance.
visualLimits: Obstructed/edge-on church, gate and chapel scouts, including the baseline1440 chapel-hill wall view, are diagnostic only. Clear paired standing views inspect church, fire station, gate variants and chapel caps; supplementary pairs at two original chapel placements show a shallow main-roof strip, not a broad aerial roof inspection. Church reception is captured CPU-lit even with HWTL enabled. Chapel native reception is zero; forced CPU reception is separately demonstrated. The exact rejecting gate is not inferred and no gate is relaxed. Route filenames describe requested states, not every model channel. Town/gate roof-family totals include existing nearby sources and are not source-specific percentages. Existing MSAA single-sample GI grain is not clean visual acceptance.
batchAcceptance: Three dedicated tile source identities accepted through existing PBR/GI paths with the per-route limits above. All64 surveyed models remain partial source reviews. Full726-model goal is incomplete.

buildArtifacts.identityLimit: These exact tested executables were built from base95ca6f8 plus the batch12 source changes before the documentation commit; source HEAD alone does not identify the loaded bytes.
